## History

Ada stopped aging once she turned thirty, even as her twin sister [Hannah](../character/hannah.md) continued to age. Later, Ada and [Hannah](../character/hannah.md) put up a 'To Let' sign on their property, Tabby's Place, in [Portmaris](../codex/places.md#portmaris), which was discovered by [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md) as they searched for a house to lease.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Farewell P21](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0021), [v3 ch.Friend P1](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0001), [v3 ch.Friend P2](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0002), [v3 ch.Friend P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013), [v3 ch.Friend P29](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0029)_
